content: The two representatives are outlining their positions on the controversy related to the Turkish invasion of Cyprus. Expressed disagreement on this topic is clearly present in the speeches, but as mentioned in the main paper, the two countries' voting ideal points for that year at the most similar amongst all NATO members.
